name: ONT raw signal tools (blue-crab, slow5tools, Squigualiser, Squigulator)
label: starting-point
notes: Four Docker images built from the Dockerfiles in docker/, each from public upstream releases: blue-crab 0.5.0, slow5tools 1.4.0, pyslow5 1.4.0, pod5 0.3.35, squigualiser 0.7.0, squigulator 0.5.0. They stay in Docker (or Podman); no .sif is made. The signal workbench compares the image id with the one in platform/api/config/ont_signal_workbench/*_policy_v1.json, and a local build gets its own id, printed in the build log. Not yet built from clean by us: expect to fix things.
